plan.purpose: two-storey house with a side-gabled roof, a deck on the garden side and a porch roof over its right half

components.name: Foundation
components.job: concrete band the walls stand on

components.name: WallCore
components.job: the frame and sheathing everything else is fixed to

components.name: Siding
components.job: lap boards, each over the one below; ends under the trim

components.name: CornerBoards
components.job: cover the siding ends; tops follow the soffit slope

components.name: Casings
components.job: line the openings, jamb boards inside, cover the board ends

components.name: Windows
components.job: sliding double sashes in the openings

components.name: Doors
components.job: garden, glass and street doors in their openings

components.name: Sheathing
components.job: the roof deck on the walls, under the overhangs

components.name: Shingles
components.job: shed the rain: two layers, over the rake and fascia

components.name: RidgeCaps
components.job: close the ridge

components.name: Fascia
components.job: eave board the gutter hangs on

components.name: Soffits
components.job: close the underside of the overhangs

components.name: RakeBoards
components.job: trim the gable edges, cover the fascia's end, cut plumb

components.name: VentPipe
components.job: plumbing vent through the roof

components.name: Gutter
components.job: collects the rain at the eave

components.name: Downspouts
components.job: from the gutter's end to the gable wall, down it, out over a splash block

components.name: SplashBlocks
components.job: lead the water away from the wall

components.name: SkirtPosts
components.job: corner posts of the deck skirt

components.name: DeckFrame
components.job: ledger on the wall, rim joists, joists every 40 cm

components.name: Decking
components.job: cedar boards resting on the joists and rim joists

components.name: Lattice
components.job: white diagonal skirt behind the posts, hides the frame

components.name: Steps
components.job: notched stringers, treads, risers up to the deck

components.name: Railing
components.job: posts bolted inside the rim joists, rails, balusters

components.name: PorchPosts
components.job: carry the porch beam, standing on the decking

components.name: PorchRoof
components.job: covers the deck's right half: ledger on the wall, beam on the posts

components.name: Lamp
components.job: gooseneck barn light right of the glass door

components.name: DoorHandles
components.job: open the doors

features.expect: notched stringers carry the treads from the ground up to the deck frame
the deck frame rests on a ledger on the wall and on posts at its outer edge
the porch roof rests on the wall and on a beam carried by the posts
each downspout leaves the gutter, runs down the wall and ends over a splash block
